investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Ardvid Bank (digital banking); Platform: Microsoft Azure eastus (zones eastus-1/eastus-2/eastus-3); network range 10.84.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster ardvid-prod-eastus (AKS); Automation: an in-house node-recycler controller rotates worker nodes (cordon, drain, terminate, replace) in batches bounded by maxUnavailable (15% of 23 nodes); runs are recorded with RECYCLE- identifiers; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
